verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator that hands a task to a coding subagent such as Claude (`yylo init --task ... --subagent claude`). It runs the work in an isolated task worktree, can repeat iterations until no open kanban work remains, and can pull GitHub issues into kanban and post completed responses back to the source thread. That gives a plausible path from a reported bug to an autonomous fix, but the diagnosis and fixing are done by the third-party agent, and tests and reviews must be configured as explicit project checks. Missing for 10: any documented bug-diagnosis or fix workflow, built-in verification that a fix resolves the reported issue, and independent or hands-on evidence of an autonomous bug fix end to end.
